race.comment: AMELIORATION (5) drops back from Saturday company at Eagle Farm, where she was sixth over 2200m in a BM70, and her prior Sunshine Coast wins as favourite reads well for this easier assignment. Sharp bounce back anticipated. COASTAL COWBOY (3) brings the sharpest last-start figure when dismantling his rivals on the course proper, though he has to reproduce that away from turf. COSMIC COCO (6) also deserves respect after some nice closing efforts, though he might land in a tricky spot from the low draw. Will be sweating on a gap to appear. SIR GOLDALOT (2) is in good touch and rarely puts in a bad performance. Drawn well and only needs to hold his form to be right there again.
